setup.needsNetworkTitle: Connect to the internet once to finish setup
setup.needsNetworkBody: Ritu needs the internet only this first time. After that it works fully offline.
setup.errorBody: Something went wrong while setting up this phone. Check your connection and try again.
setup.notConfiguredBody: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your Firebase web app keys, then restart the app.
